notes: «مِنْ رِوَايَةِ» is a formula that introduces the route, not a name; the title «[الوداع]» and the number «3200 -» are left out.
The Imam sits inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2); his words are the saying.
«وقد أخرجت في كتاب الزيارات» is the compiler's own remark: not a route.
